combo_label: Swimming × Ice Skating × 20th-Century English Choral Music

entries.clue: Twosome billed together, sharing lifts, throws and a single score
Jump grade spun through three full revolutions, the senior benchmark
Upper of the two men's lines in four-part singing, and Pavarotti's range
Hard bench you shuffle along when latecomers arrive
Grand sacred story told by singers and chorus, with no staging or scenery
Highest adult voice part, scaling the top of the stave
Most exhausting racing style, both arms hurled forward at once; also an insect
Roped corridor of water each racer keeps to; motorways have them too
Forward-launched jump with a bonus half rotation, first landed by a Norwegian
Travelling one-foot turn that ice dancers perform in matched unison
Old-school slang for swimwear, rhyming with clogs
Toe-pick jump from the back outside edge, named after an Austrian
Rough cotton rectangle you shiver inside after climbing out
Go straight to the bottom like a pebble — swimming lessons exist to stop this
